summary: Alpha Star Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval at its June 24, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting for its business combination with Xdata Group. Over 99% of shares voted in favor of the merger, reincorporation, Nasdaq listing, governance changes, and incentive plan. The deal involves Alpha Star merging into PubCo, which then acquires 100% of XDATA. No price per share, premium, or advisor details are disclosed. The high approval rate suggests minimal risk of dissent. Watch for Nasdaq listing effectiveness and the pro-forma equity valuation upon closing.
